maddeler.e:
نعتقد (form VIII)
# نَعْتَقِدُ (naʕtaqidu) /naʕ.ta.qi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# نُعْتَقَدُ (nuʕtaqadu) /nuʕ.ta.qa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# نَعْتَقِدَ (naʕtaqida) /naʕ.ta.qi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# نُعْتَقَدَ (nuʕtaqada) /nuʕ.ta.qa.da/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
